lines.text: The people go up to the rooftops, and the rulers flee together and are captured without a bow.
The prophet weeps bitterly over his people's destruction because the Lord GOD of Hosts set a day of tumult.
The people look to the weapons in the House of the Forest and tear down Samaria's houses for the wall.
The Lord calls for weeping, but the people feast, and their sin stays unatoned until their dying day.
